text:
alex-infra: Heads up — after rolling kernel 6.2.8 to a small subset of p4s in us-west1, we've started seeing the GPUs failing to initialize on boot. boot logs attached in thread.
renee-sre: seeing the same in ap-southeast1 canary. dmesg shows module unload failures + tainted module: 
```
[    3.412345] nvidia: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel.
[    3.413210] nvidia: Unknown symbol nv_alloc_pages
[    3.413567] nvidia_uvm: probe of nvidia_uvm failed with error -22
```
kevin-runtime: driver is 535.25, CUDA 12.1. modprobe returns 1 and leaves UVM missing. If we try to restart nvidia-persistenced it errors with "Cannot open /dev/nvidia0".
maria-platform: rollback option? We only pushed the kernel to a handful of hosts via the staging pool. Should we autoblock the rest?
alex-infra: I've paused the batch and flagged the kernel rollout in the console. Staged hosts are in the staging pool (staging-p4-usw1). No production hosts yet.
renee-sre: creating incident INC-2026-042 (ops-bot: created). Link: https://redwood/ops/incidents/INC-2026-042
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created by renee-sre. Severity: p2. Command runbook: /runbooks/kernel-gpu-failure
kevin-runtime: quick triage: looks like a symbol exported by the driver changed ABI or kernel removed helper. Can someone paste `modinfo nvidia` and `cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version`?
alex-infra: modinfo shows: 
```
filename:       /lib/modules/6.2.8/kernel/extra/nvidia.ko
version:        535.25
```
and /proc/driver/nvidia/version is missing (file not present).
renee-sre: attempted manual insert with `insmod nvidia.ko` -> fails same Unknown symbol. nv_alloc_pages is in nv-linux.c in driver 535, so the symbol should exist. Maybe the kernel removed spl_alloc_pages helper or changed gfp flags.
maria-platform: If this holds, capacity in ap-southeast will be reduced by ~12 p4s for the week. We should evaluate cost of spinning up temporary p4s in other regions vs throttling jobs.
kevin-runtime: can we test building the module with our current DKMS against 6.2.8 in a container quick? I can try a reproduce on a local bench and report.
alex-infra: repro branch started. If it's DKMS incompat, we may need to patch driver build flags or pin kernel ABI in rollout config.
renee-sre: created a short checklist in the incident: 
- pause kernel rollout (done)
- revert staging hosts to 6.1 (manual kernel boot selection)
- capture full dmesg and `eu-readelf -s` on nvidia.ko
- contact NVIDIA rep if we confirm missing exported symbol
- evaluate fallback routing for inference traffic
maria-platform: rerouting note: we can route low-priority training to dedicated cheaper nodes and keep hosted API on older kernels. That costs ~3.2k/day for the next 48h if we run extra capacity in eu-west.
kevin-runtime: I built a test kernel module against 6.2.8 headers and reproduced the undefined symbol locally. Looks like a change in scatterlist/gfp semantics affected nv_alloc_pages wrapper. Patch maybe needed on our side or driver vendor.
alex-infra: next steps: pin rollout, drain staging-p4-usw1, and open support ticket with NVIDIA. I put an action item on the incident for Kevin to prepare a minimal reproducer and logs.
renee-sre: adding timeline and slack updates to incident, will update cadence every 30m. Thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: automated canary rollout paused by alex-infra for 176/200 hosts.
